body:
Reported Player: AwesomeBliss

Rules Broken: Team greifing, Killing teammates in the game called Wall by using fire/lava.

Evidence: 

I saw AwesomeBliss pour lava on his team-mate. Picture:

After seeing him pour lava on his teammate before the walls fell down, I checked his inventory and he had firecharges, which he probably used on me, then he did have the lava bucket he used to kill his teammate. Picture:

I was going AFK to grab a quick drink for 10 seconds, and when I returned I was dead and it said I was burnt to death. AwesomeBliss was around me so I suspected him. Heres the picutre for this:
